_readme: 这是桌宠全部可见文案，改完运行 apply_lines.py 再重启应用即可生效。
name = 悬停时显示的名字；aria = 无障碍标签；hint = 鼠标停留提示。
line1..lineN = 点它一下随机说一句（可以加到 line9、line10…，代码会自动发现）。
chatter1..N = 你打字时它碎碎念（同样可加）。
lineReconnect / lineBroadcast / lineReturn / lineWake / lineDone / lineSent 对应固定时机。
气泡最大宽度约 13em，中文一句建议不超过 14 字，否则会折成两三行。

zh.title: Lucky桌宠
zh.description: 一只会动的 3D 鹦鹉桌宠：待机时收翅站立、轻轻呼吸；你打字它开始走；AI 开始干活它就跑起来，拿到答案时张开翅膀飞一下。

en.title: Lucky the Desk Pet
en.description: A living 3D parrot in the corner of the Harness window: it perches and breathes while idle, walks when you type, runs while the agent works, and spreads its wings to fly when the answer lands.

zh.name: Lucky
zh.aria: Lucky，一只可拖动的 3D 鹦鹉桌宠。点一下它会说话，右键看它播报。
zh.hint: 拖动我 · 点一下说话 · 右键播报
zh.line2: 先歇一会儿，我帮你看着风。
zh.line3: 这个 bug 看着眼熟，让我啄啄看。
zh.line4: 别熬太晚，我的眼圈可没你的深。
zh.line5: 我偷吃了一口你的任务列表。
zh.line6: 要跑测试吗？我可以当吉祥物。
zh.lineBroadcast: 站上栖木了 —— 试音，喂喂。
zh.lineReturn: 你回来啦，我一直在这儿。
zh.lineWake: 啊……我在！刚才只是顺了顺羽毛。

en.name: Lucky
en.aria: Lucky, a draggable 3D parrot desk pet. Click it to hear a line, right-click to see it broadcast.
en.hint: Drag me · click to talk · right-click to broadcast
en.line1: Right here — still perched on the mast.
en.line2: Take a breather. I'll keep an eye on the wind.
en.line3: That bug looks familiar. Let me peck at it.
en.line4: Don't stay up too late — my eye rings are lighter than yours.
en.line5: I took a bite out of your task list.
en.line6: Shall we run the tests? I can be the mascot.
en.lineReconnect: Reconnected — I'm back on the perch.
en.lineBroadcast: On the perch. Testing, one two.
en.lineReturn: You're back. I kept the perch warm.
en.lineWake: Ah — I'm up! I was only preening.
en.lineSent: On it. I'll fly this one out.
